name: Aluminium barrier laminate tube (ABL)
notes: Industry standard toothpaste tube; layers cannot be separated

name: Plastic barrier laminate tube (PBL)
notes: PET layer blocks the PE recycling stream

name: Mono-HDPE tube with thin EVOH
notes: EVOH under 5% of weight is accepted in PE recycling

name: Mono-PP tube with thin EVOH
notes: Needs a PP cap to stay mono-material

name: Mono-aluminium tube
notes: Excellent barrier; high CO2 from primary aluminium

name: PET/PE laminate foil
notes: Common food foil; mixed polymers and food residue

name: Metallised PET/PE foil
notes: High barrier; not recyclable in any stream

name: Mono-PE foil with AlOx coating
notes: Thin oxide coating keeps the pack in the PE stream

name: Mono-PP foil (BOPP/PP)
notes: Good moisture barrier; weak oxygen barrier

name: Mono-PE film
notes: Simplest structure; very low oxygen barrier
